title: Plasma capability/action registry (CONTRACT-006)
$comment: Contract: CONTRACT-006 | Status: SIGNED (proposed for sign-off by A, 2026-06-24; awaits team ack) | Version: 0.1.0 | Author: @anuj (Role A) | Consumed: @srujan (Role B) — emitted by org.kde.PlasmaShell.Introspect.globalCapabilities() (CONTRACT-002) and projected into MCP introspect_capabilities() (CONTRACT-003), so the model can discover what THIS build supports. This file is itself a valid JSON-Schema: an instance emitted by globalCapabilities() MUST validate against the root schema below. ID scheme: CONTRACT-001 — registry entries use `cap:<name>` and `act:<name>` stable ids; these are registry-level ids, distinct from per-instance `act:<element-id>/<name>` refs. Cross-refs: CONTRACT-002 (appletCapabilities/globalCapabilities); CONTRACT-003 (get_actions / widget_transform / introspect_capabilities).

build.description: plasma-desktop fork build id (e.g. git short sha of the plasma-workspace fork). Identifies which fork iteration produced this registry.

interfaceVersion.description: Equals the org.kde.PlasmaShell.Introspect Version property (CONTRACT-002). Consumers MUST treat a greater-than-known version defensively.

capabilities.description: Every capability the build knows about, across all element kinds. A capability is a coarse 'what can be done to an element class'; per-applet support is the subset returned by appletCapabilities(). The canonical v0.1 set is Draggable, Resizable, Rotatable, Configurable.

id.description: Stable registry id, CONTRACT-001 vocabulary. e.g. 'cap:draggable'.

name.description: Human/model-readable capability name. appletInfo('capabilities') and appletCapabilities() emit these names verbatim.

appliesTo.description: Which element kinds this capability can apply to. Mirrors CONTRACT-001 element types.

actions.description: Named actions exposed by elements, each with a per-action JSON-Schema for its args object. Backs MCP get_actions() (where the same schema is named 'schema') and the Layer 2 invoke_action/widget_transform tools.

id.description: Stable registry id, CONTRACT-001 vocabulary. e.g. 'act:rotate'. Note: per-instance action refs are 'act:<wgt:id>/<name>'; this registry id is the template.

name.description: Action name. Must match an `op` understood by CONTRACT-002 appletTransform where the action is a transform; otherwise a free name for invoke_action.

requiresCapability.description: Capability (name) that must be supported for this action to apply, or null/omitted if none. e.g. rotate requires Rotatable. Maps to appletTransform's per-axis gating.

args.description: A JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) describing this action's args object. When projected into MCP get_actions() output (CONTRACT-003) the SAME object is emitted under the key 'schema'. When passed to appletTransform it is the JSON value of the `args` parameter.
